# nlohmann/json

Version: v3.12.0 (C++11, header-only, split headers).
Upstream: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0
License: MIT; upstream copyright and SPDX notices are preserved in the headers.

The upstream raw download was unavailable in this environment. Headers and the
redistribution license were extracted from the PyPI repackaging, not installed
as a Python runtime dependency:

- Package: nlohmann_json-3.12.0-py3-none-any.whl
- Distribution: https://pypi.org/project/nlohmann-json/3.12.0/
- Download: https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/packages/51/69/a42fddc89a6de959b65b27a15d69de85e88d2f99884e00b1b02c12dce301/nlohmann_json-3.12.0-py3-none-any.whl
- Wheel SHA-256: 5f6132720fb25d0d70bf0742f8397b49a540dcc193e7312a914f6aa49f054810

SHA256SUMS records the installed files. Include <nlohmann/json.hpp> with
-Ithird_party/nlohmann_json/include. No library link step is required.

LICENSE.MIT contains the upstream MIT license, retrieved from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/LICENSE.MIT
via the web tool. LICENSE is the PyPI redistribution license.
